name: pocket-lab-lite
description: Lightweight Pocket Lab for low-power Android/Termux and edge devices

scripts.validate:pwa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:mock-regression: npm run build-storybook && npm run test:e2e:mocked && npm run test:phase9:qualification && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:a11y:states && npm run test:content-stress && npm run test:visual && npm run test:visual:states && npm run test:visual:overlays
scripts.build:budget: npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:n6b: vitest run src/lib/liteNativeInstall.test.js src/lib/liteServiceWorkerRuntime.test.js src/lite/liteNavigationRuntime.test.js src/lib/liteOfflineReadPolicy.test.js
scripts.test:ux:maturity: vitest run src/lib/liteUxPresentation.test.js && VITE_POCKETLAB_MOCKS=1 LITE_E2E_MODE=mocked playwright test tests/e2e/lite-ux-maturity.spec.ts --project=mocked-desktop --project=mocked-mobile
scripts.test:perf:mocked: rm -rf .pocketlab-dev/performance && VITE_POCKETLAB_PERF_TEST=1 LITE_E2E_MODE=mocked playwright test tests/e2e/lite-performance.spec.ts --project=mocked-desktop --project=mocked-mobile && npm run check:render-budgets
scripts.test:perf:live: if [ "${LITE_PERF_PRESERVE_EVIDENCE:-0}" != "1" ]; then rm -rf .pocketlab-dev/performance; fi; VITE_POCKETLAB_PERF_TEST=1 LITE_E2E_MODE=live LITE_E2E_LIVE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/lite-performance-live.spec.ts --project=live-desktop --project=live-mobile && npm run check:render-budgets

scripts.test:perf:qualification: npm run test:perf:components && npm run build:budget && npm run test:perf:mocked
scripts.test:perf:interactions: rm -rf .pocketlab-dev/performance && VITE_POCKETLAB_PERF_TEST=1 LITE_E2E_MODE=mocked playwright test tests/e2e/lite-performance.spec.ts --grep "\\[interaction\\]" --project=mocked-desktop --project=mocked-mobile && npm run check:render-budgets
